summary: A move in the rules: Your side can only win {the fight} by a move in the rules: {the move}.
realLife: One life: The night before the 2013 shutdown, a House rules change made the majority leader the only member who could force a vote on the Senate's funding bill. He did not allow it, which critics said made the shutdown longer. Another: When Wisconsin Senate Democrats left the state in 2011 to deny a quorum, Republicans stripped the spending provisions so the bill could pass without one. A judge struck the law down over open-meetings rules, and the state supreme court reinstated it.
